assertions.issues: Regression criterion holds: the day the Today screen is on (businessDate 2026-10-16, its 'Business date' control, all 13 rows, counters 11 parties / 30 covers) equals the day-feed default and the expected service day; the pre-fix UTC fallback (which would say 2026-10-17) is gone from the feed. Reported for the parent's judgement, not as a failure of this criterion: (1) the module header Date control (#reservations-date-input) still defaults to the UTC calendar date 2026-10-17 - apps/app/app/routes/_app+/$orgSlug_+/reservations+/_layout.tsx:98 'todayDate: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)', used at :113 - visible on the same screen as the Today view's 10/16/2026; it does not drive the Today list (today.tsx reads host.businessDate from the feed, and the feed was requested without a date). (2) The client-computed 'today' behind the 'Jump to Today' button is also 2026-10-17: apps/app/app/utils/reservations/book-api.ts:1526 maps 'dayStartMin: Number(raw.dayStartMin ?? 0)' while the payload carries it at settings.dayStartMin (240), so useLiveNow (use-host-stand.ts:103-110, todayDate: liveNow.businessDate at :285) collapses to the plain calendar date in the location tz and the button is shown ('Jump to Today' target = 2026-10-17, i.e. not the current service day). Observed live at 04:07:42Z: headerDateInput=2026-10-17, hostBusinessDateInput=2026-10-16, subnavProps.todayDate=2026-10-17, jump button present.

summary: Two round-3 regressions re-verified on 521df7ed with zero product writes from this validator. VAL-BOOK-011 (business date) PASS: at 04:0x UTC on 2026-10-17 (New York 00:0x EDT), the day feed called with no date parameter returns businessDate '2026-10-16', 13 reservations and counters {parties 11, covers 30} from both the browser capture and curl with a book-scope token (no token 401, wrong-secret token 401); the Today view's 'Business date' control, the 13 rendered rows (6 upcoming / 4 seated / 3 finished cards) and the KPIs (30 covers / 11 parties) all match that service day - the pre-fix UTC fallback is gone. Documented separately: the module header Date control still defaults to the UTC date 2026-10-17 (_layout.tsx:98) and the client-computed 'Jump to Today' target is 2026-10-17 because book-api.ts:1526 maps dayStartMin to 0 instead of settings.dayStartMin, so that button aims at the calendar day rather than the service day. VAL-SETUP-025 (conflicts panel + dry run) PASS: the panel renders all 10 conflicts as 'CODE · date · Party of N' with localized reasons, matching the GET payload item-for-item and the tenant DB rows (codes, dates, party sizes all cross-checked); the GET answers 401 without a token and 200 twice with a setup-scope token (identical bodies), and read-only sqlite snapshots taken with the same queries before and after three browser panel loads plus two curl GETs are identical in every value - rsv_day_versions (24 rows, e.g. 2026-10-16->19, 2026-10-17->15, 2026-10-20->45), rsv_reservation_events COUNT 253 with unchanged per-type counts and MAX(at), rsv_table_occupancies COUNT 160, the last 5 rsv_reservations.updated_at, MAX(rsv_day_versions.updated_at) and the reservation count 112 - so the conflicts GET is now a true dry run.
